body.purpose: Instructional prose and readable interface text.

label.purpose: Topic, field, phase, and action labels.

mono.purpose: Instruction words, addresses, encoded values, and code.

shadows.name: mobile-topic-popover
shadows.purpose: Separates the expanded mobile Topics menu from the work area.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Brief color and surface changes on controls, navigation, and diagram nodes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable transitions and animations when requested.

components.name: Welcome Action
components.description: The clear starting action from the welcome screen into datapath practice.
components.css: .ds-welcome-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; min-height: 54px; margin-top: 35px; padding: 15px 23px; border: 1px solid #a9c5e6; border-radius: 7px; background: #a9c5e6; color: #13253a; font: 600 16px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-welcome-action:hover { border-color: #c4d7ee; background: #c4d7ee; } .ds-welcome-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Practice Button
components.description: Checks the learner's prediction or advances a completed step.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid #a9c5e6; border-radius: 7px; background: #a9c5e6; color: #13253a; font: 550 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background .15s; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #c4d7ee; border-color: #c4d7ee; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Practice Button
components.description: A supporting or explicit reveal action beside the main practice action.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid #465365; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #c8d3e3; font: 550 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background .15s; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #354357; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: default; }

components.name: Practice Input
components.description: A readable numeric or short text prediction field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: #c1cdde; font: 500 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid #465365; border-radius: 7px; background: #11161e; color: #e5ecf7; font: 400 15px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #9aa8bc; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Desktop Topic Link
components.description: A persistent topic choice in the desktop learning navigation.
components.css: .ds-topic-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 7px; color: #aeb8c7; font: 400 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-topic-link:hover { background: #212833; color: #fff; } .ds-topic-link[aria-current='page'] { background: #263447; color: #e8edf3; } .ds-topic-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Learning Panel
components.description: A flat work surface for one exercise or processor subsystem.
components.html:
Current register state

State updates at the rising edge.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid #303946; border-radius: 12px; background: #181d25; color: #e8edf3; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #e8edf3; font: 550 18px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #a4afbd; font: 400 15px/1.65 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Mobile Topics Disclosure
components.description: A native expandable topic menu with progress and mixed review inside.
components.css: .ds-topics { position: relative; color: #e8edf3; font: 400 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-topics > summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #3b495d; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-topics > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-topics > summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-topics[open] { position: absolute; z-index: 30; top: 0; right: 0; width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 40px)); max-height: calc(100svh - 35px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #3b495d; border-radius: 9px; background: #181e28; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px #05070b80; } .ds-topics[open] > summary { border: 0; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-topics nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-topics nav a { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 7px; color: #aeb8c7; text-decoration: none; } .ds-topics nav a:hover { background: #212833; color: #fff; }

components.name: Instruction Field Chip
components.description: A field label learners can drag or select before placing into a bit range.
components.css: .ds-field-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #53647a; border-radius: 7px; background: #202a37; color: #d6e3f3; font: 550 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; cursor: grab; } .ds-field-chip:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #8ba6c5; background: #29384a; } .ds-field-chip:active:not(:disabled) { cursor: grabbing; } .ds-field-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #b5d2f2; background: #33475f; color: #f1f7ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #a9c8ed40; } .ds-field-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Scrollable Instruction Field Strip
components.description: An overflow-contained 32-bit layout; the scroll cue is shown when the strip is wider than its viewport.
components.html: Scroll sideways for all bit ranges.
components.css: .ds-field-layout { min-width: 0; } .ds-strip-scroll { width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; border: 1px solid #3a4859; border-radius: 9px; background: #121821; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #52647b #171e27; } .ds-bit-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(32, minmax(36px, 1fr)); width: 100%; min-width: 1152px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #141b25; } .ds-bit-strip.ds-b-strip { grid-template-columns: repeat(32, minmax(44px, 1fr)); min-width: 1408px; } .ds-bit-slot { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 82px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 3px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #3d4a5b; border-radius: 0; background: #202a37; color: #d8e4f2; font: 400 14px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; touch-action: pan-x; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; } .ds-bit-slot:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2b394b; } .ds-bit-slot:focus-visible { z-index: 2; outline: 2px solid #a7c8ed; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-scroll-cue { margin: 10px 0 0; color: #a4afbd; font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Datapath Signal Key
components.description: A recurring legend that maps signal color and line style to hardware role.
components.css: .ds-signal-key { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 17px; color: #aeb9c9; font: 400 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-signal-key > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; } .ds-data-wire { display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 2px; background: #93b5d8; } .ds-control-wire { display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed #d6b281; } .ds-state-node { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid #bda6da; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a focused technical instrument. Dark slate surfaces leave room for the mechanism, its live values, and the learner's next decision. The welcome screen offers a single Open lab action beside a small vector circuit; once inside, one clear task leads each topic. Course identity stays quiet and supporting copy stays brief.

Color carries processor meaning: blue identifies data and primary actions, amber identifies control, and lilac identifies clocked state. A larger, more readable type scale keeps the instructional interface legible; the responsive layout moves the question and required state ahead of the wide diagram on smaller screens. Practice waits for a prediction or an explicit reveal before exposing an answer. Field placement works with pointer drag, tap selection, or keyboard activation.
keyCharacteristics: Dark slate instrument surfaces, quiet boundaries, and no raster artwork or decorative card collage.
Blue data, amber control, and lilac sequential state cues.
Task-first layouts with readable labels and touch-sized controls.
Explicit answers in Practice; no automatic answer hints.

rules.name: The Signal Meaning Rule
rules.body: Blue stays with data and primary actions, amber with control, and lilac with clocked state.

rules.name: The Readable Workbench Rule
rules.body: Keep labels and body copy at the implemented 14px and 15px baseline; reserve smaller text for dense diagram annotations that have adjacent explanation.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve drop shadow for the open navigation popover; use surface tone and borders to group ordinary learning content.

dos: Do keep the dark slate workbench and the established data, control, and state color roles.
Do use concise, task-specific guidance and let learners request help when they want it.
Do preserve the 44px control baseline and 14px navigation/label scale.
Do put the task and relevant state before the wide diagram on narrow screens.
Do support pointer, touch, and keyboard field placement, visible focus, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add automatic answer hints to Practice; reveal answers only after a learner action.
Don't turn the screen into a course-branding page, a raster-art hero, or a decorative card collage.
Don't compress the datapath or instruction strip until its labels stop being readable.
Don't add shadows to ordinary panels; reserve them for the expanded mobile topic menu.
